name: Noon Chai (Pink Tea)
ingredients: Optional: Crushed almonds and pistachios for garnish
instructions: 1. Boil water in a large pot (samovar or heavy pan) and add the green tea leaves and baking soda.
2. Boil until the water reduces significantly and turns dark red.
3. Add a splash of ice-cold water and whisk vigorously; repeat this aeration process until the color deepens.
4. Add fresh water and continue boiling until a thick, dark concentrate remains.
5. Strain the decoction and keep it aside.
6. To serve, heat the desired amount of concentrate, add full-fat milk, and simmer until it turns a light pink color.
7. Stir in salt to taste and garnish with crushed nuts if desired.
description: Noon Chai is a signature Kashmiri beverage, integral to the social fabric of the region. Served traditionally in a samovar, this salty, pink-hued tea is a symbol of warmth and hospitality, typically enjoyed during breakfast or afternoon tea sessions with breads like Kulcha or Girda.
